changelog.change: Now writes the splits' region, Uses Emulator and variables from Edit Splits.
Now writes LiveSplit's custom variables, such as a death count, with the new Custom variables setting.
SplitList now scrolls along with the mouse wheel over LiveSplit.
Fixes: before the start, the timers show the Start timer at time; closing LiveSplit resets the files; renamed splits and comparisons show straight away.
Now checks for updates to this component.
